correctness.rationale: Every ordinary derivation has quotient matrix A and central scalar tr(A), every ordinary automorphism has A invertible and central scalar det(A). For pairwise interpolation, necessity gives homogeneity, quotient-independence of central coordinate, and (in the automorphism case) a permutation of projective lines and injective vertical sections. The sufficiency proof constructs witnesses case-by-case: independent quotient vectors fix A and allow independent central functional interpolation; for dependent quotients w=t v but linearly independent whole elements, the scalar kappa=(g(tv,d)-t g(v,c))/(d-t c) can be achieved as an arbitrary trace, or as a nonzero determinant because central scaling/fibre injection forces kappa nonzero. The homogeneous-function/projective-permutation counts give q^(q^2+3q+3) and (q+1)!(q-1)^(q+2)(q!)^(q+1). The standalone verifier exhaustively checks 8192 and 48 classified maps over F2 against every pair and ordinary witness; randomized ternary tests check 150 maps per type. Neither finite test proves the all-field theorem.

value.rationale: The exact full nonlinear 2-local symmetry classification of the smallest nonabelian nilpotent Lie algebra is a natural complete classification, not a one-off counterexample.
